text:
Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey and Slayer are DJs in GTA 6. Rockstar just confirmed it.
Six radio stations went live on the official site, with two minute previews.
Bad Bunny runs the Latin station. Lana Del Rey and Morgan Wallen host country. Burna Boy takes African music. And two members of Slayer run a full metal station.
Flash FM, the pop station from Vice City, is back after twenty-four years. Robyn hosts it. Trick Daddy and Trina handle southern rap.
But here's the twist. For the first time ever, you can listen to radio and on-demand podcasts on foot. Just put in your headphones.
And there are more stations we haven't heard yet.
So which station are you tuning into first? Tell me below.
